svg.aria-label: The table shows whether Ghidra has each CPU family built in or by extension, and whether Unicorn 2 and Capstone support it. The 8-bit families have no Unicorn support.
svg.title: The table shows whether Ghidra has each CPU family built in or by extension, and whether Unicorn 2 and Capstone support it. The 8-bit families have no Unicorn support.
svg.text: The table covers Ghidra 12.1.4, Unicorn 2.1.4 and Capstone next (6.0.0-Alpha11).
Where Unicorn has nothing, take ground truth from a small core such as py65, iz80, Musashi, Moira or MAME's cores.
